emdr.heading: 🎯 What is EMDR Therapy?
emdr.p1: EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) is a scientifically based method of psychotherapy for treating post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), anxiety disorders and psychological trauma.
emdr.p2: Our platform uses bilateral stimulation — the movement of a ball creates bilateral brain stimulation, helping to process traumatic memories.

privacy.s2SessionP1: When creating an EMDR therapy session, the Site generates a unique session identifier. This identifier is stored temporarily in the server's RAM and does not contain personal data. The identifier is automatically deleted when the session ends or after a period of inactivity.
privacy.s2NoCollectLi1: names, surnames or other identifying data;
